# Copilot Instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` first. It is the shared source of truth for architecture, providers, env vars, and product defaults.

Important defaults:
- This is a Next.js + TypeScript + Supabase AI-influencer SaaS MVP.
- Use Nano Banana Pro / Gemini for image generation.
- Use the Wan-compatible video adapter for `wan-2.2` and `wan-animate`.
- Do not add Kling; it was removed from scope.
- Keep demo-mode fallbacks working when provider keys are absent.
